2 Methods

The initial ULEZ was introduced in April 2019 and encompassed only the area of inner London already in the congestion charge zone. The first expansion in October 2021 increased the boundary to the North and South Circular Roads, while the most recent expansion has brought all of Greater London and some areas of surrounding counties within the zone. Figure 1 shows a map of the three stages of the ULEZ, compiled using ArcGIS.
